race.comment: LA ROJA (13) resumes and shoulders irresistible form references, having flashed home in the LR Eye Liner Stakes when beaten a neck back in June, on the back of finishing a narrow second to Declichy Boulevard at Randwick the run prior. Has been readied with two trials for the new yard and keeps Thompson on. Bold showing anticipated. NO FOOLING (2) is the race-fit danger after winning comfortably here last month despite knuckling at the start. The horse behind him has since come out and won well here on the weekend. Maloney sticking from a low draw makes him a serious threat. TASMAN BAY (7) is in excellent form, has won at this track and distance and beat NO FOOLING at this venue about a month ago, so her profile is hard to dismiss. Expect her to be the one they need to reel in. CRYPTIC BEAUTY (9) has been around the mark all campaign and arrives off a Gold Coast win as favourite. Is another can inject some good speed into the race and should be competitive.
